job.description: <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">SLSQ227R839</p> <h2>The Team</h2> <p>The Partner Development Center (PDC) develops Databricks' C&amp;SI partner ecosystem at scale. We accelerate the growth of Rising 100 and active Bronze partners through structured, high-touch engagement, while driving systematic activation of Bronze partners through AI-powered automation.</p> <p>Rising 100 partners receive business plan-led, white-glove engagement: structured development plans, biweekly cadence, and accountability to measurable GTM milestones.</p> <p>Active Bronze partners are engaged through cohort-based programs designed to build the next generation of high-performing Databricks partners.</p> <h2>The Role</h2> <p>This India-based Sr. Alliance Manager is the dedicated PDC resource for EMEA and APJ. You will manage approximately 50 Rising 100 C&amp;SI partners across both regions, with additional accountability for Bronze-tier cohort activation.</p> <p>You will own the full partner development lifecycle: joint business plan design and coaching, Bronze-to-Silver progression mechanics, and co-sell coordination with field sales. Daily work involves AEs, Solution Architects, Partner Marketing, Enablement, Legal, and Ops across multiple time zones.</p> <p>This role reflects Databricks' deepening investment in India. As we expand COE partnerships with leading global SIs, this hire is the face of that investment for our EMEA and APJ partner ecosystem.</p> <h2>What You'll Do</h2> <p><strong>Rising 100 White-Glove Engagement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and manage Joint Business Plans (JBPs) with ~50 Rising 100 SI partners: quarterly KPI setting, milestone tracking, and biweekly coaching cadences.</li> <li>Drive partners against Rising 100 health metrics: sourced MRR trajectory, certification milestones, 90-day pipeline activity, and Partner Value Score (PVS) lift.</li> <li>Own the opt-in commitment model: partner selection, goal-setting, and entry/exit criteria enforcement within your regional cohort.</li> <li>Act as the regional escalation point for Rising 100 partners. Track where each partner stands against their next milestone before they ask.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bronze Scale Motion and Cohort Activation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and run cohort-based engagement programs for Bronze-tier partners pursuing Silver. Use regional data signals to sequence and prioritize outreach.</li> <li>Drive partner adoption of milestone-based onboarding: Learning Path completion, Sales Badge attainment, deal registration, and first high-intent lead.</li> <li>Leverage Salesforce, Outreach, and partner portals to manage engagement at scale. Human touchpoints are allocated based on partner readiness and commercial potential.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PDC Operations and Cross-Functional Coordination</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own PDC Office Hours and regional partners@ alias management for EMEA/APJ.</li> <li>Coordinate co-sell opportunities with field AEs, driving partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline with local country sales and alliance leaders.</li> <li>Work with Ops and Enablement to identify and remove onboarding friction for India-based development center partners navigating Brickbuilder, certification tracks, and deal registration workflows.</li> <li>Bring the voice of the EMEA/APJ partner ecosystem into PDC program design. Distinguish systemic issues from coaching gaps.</li> </ul> <h2>What We Look For</h2> <p><strong>Non-Negotiable</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years in Partner Sales or Partner Management at a top-tier or high-growth enterprise tech company, with direct, external, partner-facing responsibility.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record designing partner engagement programs: KPI setting, cohort design, tier progression mechanics, and accountability to business outcomes.</li> <li>Cloud ecosystem fluency: working experience with at least one hyperscaler partner program (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including tier mechanics, certification tracks, deal registration, and co-sell motions.</li> <li>Measurable partner outcomes on record: sourced pipeline, certification attainment, tier progression, or equivalent program KPIs.</li> <li>Ability to operate autonomously across global time zones with no local PDC team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred</strong></p> <ul> <li>Direct Databricks ecosystem exposure: Brickbuilder program, Partner Value Score (PVS), Bronze/Silver tier requirements, or Databricks Academy certification tracks.</li> <li>Experience managing segmented partner populations using data signals to sequence and prioritize outreach across a large cohort.</li> <li>India-based SI/consulting ecosystem familiarity: how GSIs like TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Persistent, or Nagarro structure their delivery practices, certification investments, and hyperscaler alliance programs.</li> <li>Proficiency with Salesforce, Outreach, partner portals, and BI or analytics tools (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent).</li> <li>Experience facilitating virtual enablement sessions: office hours, 1:few partner workshops, webinars.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Person</strong></p> <ul> <li>Commercial orientation: you read business plans and ask what is actually driving the number. You know when a partnership is performing and when it is coasting.</li> <li>Connector: you know which conversation to have and who needs to be in the room. You bring field AEs, partner leadership, and Databricks product teams to the same table when it matters.</li> <li>Truth-seeker: you go to the source. When data and anecdote conflict, you ask why. You surface what is systemic versus what is fixable through coaching.</li> <li>Partner experience: you think about what this program feels like from the partner's side. Friction in onboarding, slow follow-up, and vague milestone criteria are not small things.</li> <li>Autonomous operator: you identify what needs to happen, align the right stakeholders, and move. You follow up before being asked.</li> </ul> <h2>What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days</h2> <ul> <li>Joint Business Plans reviewed and refreshed for all active Rising 100 EMEA/APJ partners.</li> <li>Regional partner scorecard established: PVS baseline, sourced MRR pipeline, certification count, and deal registration volume per cohort.</li> <li>Bronze cohort engagement sequence designed and piloted for at least one EMEA segment.</li> <li>Key cross-functional relationships established with regional field AEs/SAs, local country alliance leaders (including EMEA Alliance team), and Partner Marketing.</li> <li>PDC Office Hours running on a cadenced schedule for EMEA/APJ time zones.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. job.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>About <strong>Zscaler</strong></p> <p>Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an <strong>AI-forward enterprise</strong>, we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.</p> <p>Here, <strong>impact in your role matters more than title</strong> and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value <strong>constructive, honest debate</strong>—we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on <strong>customer obsession</strong>, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.</p> <p>We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.</p></div><p><strong>Role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Sr. Product Marketing Manager – AI Protect to join our team. This is a hybrid role based in San Jose, reporting to the VP, Product Marketing – AI Security in the Marketing department.&nbsp;Enterprise security teams are navigating a two-front AI challenge: employees are adopting AI tools faster than security teams can track, creating data exposure risks and shadow AI sprawl — while adversaries are weaponizing AI to launch faster, harder-to-detect attacks. AI Protect is Zscaler's answer to both. As the Sr. PMM for AI Protect, you will own the go-to-market strategy, positioning, and field enablement for one of Zscaler's most strategically important and competitively active product lines — taking a sharp, differentiated story to market and equipping the global sales organization to win.</p> <p>This role is for someone who combines competitive sharpness with genuine customer obsession — someone who understands how security teams think, what keeps them up at night, and how to build the tools that give sellers an unfair advantage.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do (Role Expectations)</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own Marketing Strategy and Execution:</strong> Drive positioning, messaging, and cross-functional launch execution for AI Protect; partner closely with Product Management to translate roadmap investments into compelling market narratives.</li> <li><strong>Develop Impactful Messaging:</strong> Create highly differentiated messaging across AI Protect’s core pillars: securing employee AI adoption (shadow AI, AI DLP, GenAI visibility) and defending against AI-powered threats (adversarial AI, AI-driven attacks).</li> <li><strong>Build Deep Persona Understanding:</strong> Establish a profound grasp of the multi-persona buying center—including Data Security owners, SecOps teams, Risk/Compliance officers, and CISOs—and develop tailored content for each.</li> <li><strong>Lead Competitive Intelligence:</strong> Monitor the competitive landscape, synthesize actionable insights, and actively enable the field to confidently differentiate Zscaler's offerings and win deals.</li> <li><strong>Drive Sales Enablement Programs:</strong> Build robust field tools—including battlecards, objection handlers, and targeted sales plays—that equip account teams to navigate complex buying cycles and accelerate revenue.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are (Success Profile)</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are relentlessly curious. The AI threat landscape moves faster than any analyst report. New attack techniques, new tools, new buyer anxieties — you stay ahead of all of it, form your own point of view, and bring that perspective to everything you build.</li> <li>You have the courage to be bold. You write competitive content with conviction. You take positions others hedge around and make sharp, arguable claims — then back them up — because that's what earns the attention of buyers who've heard every security vendor's story before.</li> <li>You care deeply. job.title: Growth Partnerships Manager
job.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Why join us</strong></p> <p>Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.</p> <p>Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.</p></div><p><strong>Sales at Brex</strong></p> <p>Sales is the growth engine at Brex. We bring in new customers, expand existing relationships, and drive the company’s bottom line. With unlimited territories and uncapped opportunity, your ambition sets the ceiling. We win together, celebrate often, and reward performance. If you want to sell a category-defining product with real ownership, this is your team.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p>As the Growth Partnerships Manager at Brex, you will own the entire partner ecosystem for our celebrated rewards and perks program across all Brex segments. We've already transformed Brex points into a major real-world flex—offering everything from free DoorDash DashPass and 5% credit back, to exclusive experiences like private dining, sports suites, and high-profile swag and billboards.</p> <p>Now, we need a strategic builder to take ownership of these partnerships, drive increased usage and deepen customer loyalty all while building momentum by forging powerful new partnerships.&nbsp;This role requires a deep understanding of what truly motivates our customers. You will be responsible for the full product partnership lifecycle: conceiving the idea, partnering with EPD, executing the launch, growing the relationship, and scaling new initiatives.</p> <p>If you have experience as a founder or have excelled in business development, partnerships and/or growth roles, this is the perfect opportunity to have a massive impact on Brex’s growth trajectory.</p> <p><strong>Where you’ll work</strong></p> <p>This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and grow our partnerships with DoorDash, BoomPop, BetterSwag, and source the next wave of partners for our growing rewards and perks program</li> <li>Quarterback with both marketing and operations to design and drive customer acquisition end-to-end: email, in-product, social, live moments</li> <li>Champion challenging &amp; impactful product builds including placements, APIs, tracking, and attribution</li> <li>Partner closely with our marketing teams to connect our offerings to both customer value and market / cultural trends</li> <li>Enable and train customer facing teams&nbsp; to drive value through perks by developing one-pagers, talk tracks, micro-demos, and pitch materials</li> <li>Share program success internally using data including dashboards, insights, program updates, and priorities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ex-founder&nbsp;or 3+ years in business development, partnerships and/or growth at a fast-growing company</li> <li>Scrappy operator who can pitch at 10am, ship a landing page by 4pm, post it at 6pm</li> <li>Strong ownership, high bias to action, world-class written comms</li> <li>Creative with internet instincts and taste for what gets reach on X/LinkedIn and aligns with the Brex brand</li> <li>Product-curious: can build a lightweight PRD, advocate for an API, or debug a flow</li> <li>Analytical: build and monitor funnel reporting, design experiments, model in sheets or SQL, and synthesize results</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, marketing, or a related field</li> <li>Familiarity with financial products, credit cards, and business finance</li> <li>Keen awareness of the competitive landscape, industry trends, and market dynamics</li> <li>Familiarity with tools such as Figma, Hex, Looker or emerging coding tools</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>The expected OTE range for this role is $135,600 - $169,500. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance.&nbsp; Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://brex.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://brex.com" data-sk="tooltip_parent">brex.com</a>&nbsp;domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.</em></p></div>
